intents.name: DELIVERY_SHIPPING_STATUS
intents.description: Customer asking where their order is, reporting late or missing deliveries, tracking issues.

intents.name: REFUND_CANCELLATION_BILLING
intents.description: Customer asking to cancel an order, complaining about Prime membership charges, or requesting/chasing a refund.

intents.name: WRONG_OR_DEFECTIVE_ITEM
intents.description: Customer reporting a broken, defective, crushed, or incorrect product delivered.

intents.name: NON_ENGLISH_QUERY
intents.description: Customer speaking in a language other than English (e.g. Spanish, French).

intents.name: FEEDBACK_CHITCHAT
intents.description: Customer giving general feedback, saying thanks, 'done', or unrelated chat.
